loop.top3_why: The plain mean of the full pool (strategy A) achieves the lowest validation score (0.7056) and shows consistent performance across all three validation windows (0.716, 0.683, 0.716). loop.top3_why_not: Strategy B, while theoretically appealing for handling correlated errors, has a highly unstable per‑window performance (0.964, 0.488, 1.481) and a validation score far above the leader, indicating over‑fitting to the few windows. Strategy C, though more stable than B, still shows a higher validation score (0.8787) and a larger per‑window spread, making it less reliable than the plain mean for this trend‑dominated, low‑seasonality series.
